description: Stable, add-only diagnostic error codes (ADR-0983). Never remove, renumber or change the kind of a code; mark a retired one deprecated.

codes.summary: The soul is paused; the owner resumes it before it launches.
The soul's sandbox account is not ready.
The soul's sandbox belongs to a different OS account.
The persona policy could not be read.
The persona policy changed since it was approved; the owner verifies before launch.
The persona policy needs an add-on that is not installed.
A declared runtime could not be downloaded.
A downloaded runtime did not match its declared checksum.
A declared runtime has no build for this platform.
A declared runtime could not be installed.
A user runtime override is invalid.
A user runtime override has no build for this platform.
The soul's harness tool home could not be created or written.
The soul's tool-home record is invalid.
A provider secret the soul declares is not set.
A provider secret could not be read.
The soul's provider declaration is invalid.
The harness is signed out for this soul.
agent-bot has no such harness.
The harness is disabled on this host.
The harness CLI is not an executable file on this host.
The owner-activated SOP launch policy denied the launch.
The SOP launch policy could not be checked.
A policy denial's receipt could not be written, so the launch was refused.
A policy-unavailable receipt could not be written, so the launch was refused.
A metrics source could not be collected for an unspecified reason.
Diagnostic events could not be recorded; the count is in the detail.
The daemon stopped before it was ready to serve.
A daemon is already running for this account.
A harness turn failed for a reason without its own code.
A harness turn was cancelled before it finished.
The harness process exited before the turn finished.
The harness process could not be started.
The owner denied a turn approval.
A turn approval expired before the owner decided.
A turn approval was cancelled with its turn.
A turn approval request failed.
A credential request came without a live agent binding.
The bound soul is retired and gets no App token.
The bound soul has no transcript locator yet.
The github-identity add-on is off on this host.
The bound soul has no GitHub App.
The bound soul's identity record could not be read.
The App installation token could not be minted.
A wake found its soul paused; the messages wait.
A wake found no warm socket and cold wake off for the soul; the messages wait.
Every warm socket failed to take a wake frame.
The cold wake path failed or answered outside its contract.
The wake outcome could not be reported to the broker.
A team start's Python or uv-tool installs were not approved by the owner, so nothing was installed.
A caller or setting claimed a stronger enforcement profile than the one in force (0.4 T21); nothing was done.
Minting with an App key held on this host is off (legacy local custody); mint through the identity service or opt in before the removal date.
The identity service is unreachable, timed out or answered unavailable (0.4 credential_unavailable); nothing was issued and local work continues.
The identity service revoked this device (0.4 device_revoked); cached credentials were dropped and nothing mints until re-enrollment.
A credential request may have been fulfilled upstream but the answer was lost (0.4 outcome_unknown); reconcile by lookup, never retry blindly.
An operation ID was reused for a different credential request or after its credential expired (0.4 operation_conflict).
The soul's provider baseUrl is on the loopback inference proxy, which is not running there; the launch is refused rather than given the key (#1190).
The identity service pins this soul to another enrolled device; it vouches only from that device (#1196).
The identity service rate-limited a live-session events request (429 rate_limited); the caller backs off.
A live-session events request reached the daemon from a soul with no harness App slug to send as; refused instead of guessing.
The reply target has not messaged this harness recently enough (403 recipient_stale); the reply is refused, not held.
The identity service refused an events/poll: the device's scope does not cover the harness (-32024); refused, never retried as another harness.
The identity service rejected an events/poll cursor (-32602): malformed or from a different subscription; the stored cursor is left in place for the owner to reset.
An events --ide request came from a caller carrying a soul marker (Agent ID, binding or App identity); souls must use the daemon/binding path, refused instead of mixing trust planes.
The identity service answered events/edgeTicket with -32026 Unsupported: edge push is not configured for this deployment; callers fall back to events/poll.
The bound worktree has no GitHub origin remote, so the daemon cannot pick a repository for a server-mode credential mint; check the worktree with agent-bot doctor.
The bound soul has no GitHub App recorded, so the daemon cannot answer notices for it.
Notices need server mode: AGENT_BOT_SERVER is unset or the device is not enrolled.
The bound App slug resolves to no server harness this device is enrolled for, so the notices queue cannot be addressed.
The soul's private App belongs to a different owner account/org than the checkout's origin, so it can never mint an installation token there.
This provider conversation is already bound as a session of a different soul; a transcript belongs to one soul (ADR-1257).
The session's stated Agent ID differs from the soul the bind token names; nothing was consumed or changed.
A bind named a retired soul; the single-use token is left in place. Join another soul or remove the worktree pin.
A write tool was passed to the read-only call_tool meta-tool; nothing ran. Run it through call_write_tool.
A read tool was passed to call_write_tool; nothing ran. Run it through call_tool.
describe_tool, call_tool or call_write_tool named a tool that does not exist.
The MCP doctor tool could not run `agent-bot doctor --json` or parse its report.
The MCP guide tool named a topic no bundled skill reference covers.
POST /v0/machine or the client named a verb outside status, receipts, plan, apply, update.
An agent-machine field failed the wire shape (string, 1..128 chars, restricted alphabet).
The agent-machine socket refused or dropped the connection.
agent-machine did not answer within the client timeout.
The agent-machine reply was unsigned or malformed.
The agent-machine reply signature does not verify against the pinned daemon key.
The agent-machine reply timestamp is outside the +-5 minute window.
No daemon.pub pin exists; run agent-bot machine pair first.
Legacy top-level peer.* files exist beside peers/; agent-machine has not run since the layout moved.
peers/ contains a file that is not a known client key; agent-machine would refuse to start.
agent-machine's directory or daemon.pub is absent; install and start it first.
agent-machine's daemon.pub differs from the pinned key; re-pair with --repin.
A supplied field disagrees with a value the daemon derives from the binding (soul, harness, session).
The agent-machine reply verifies but its request_nonce is absent or not the request we sent.
The /v0/identity/apps request body was not valid JSON.
No /v0/identity/apps route matches the path.
The dream subsystem is not configured on this daemon.
A dream control's audit receipt could not be confirmed written.
The dream history query fields are invalid.
The owner-consent surface needed for the decision is unavailable.
agent-bot-keyd could not ask, and the loosening has no administrator-dialog fallback.
The config file changed between settings proposal and approval; the write was refused.
